Additional information
Bilal hopes to expand his business and to move to larger premises. He is considering the following
options.
Option A: Renting out the whole of the current business premises and taking out a lease on new
premises.
Option B: Selling the current business premises and using the proceeds to partly finance the
purchase of new premises. He is aware that he will also need a bank loan to finance the balance
of the purchase price of the new premises.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Advise Bilal which option he should choose. Justify your choice by discussing both options.

Additional information
The following information is available about pay rates for direct labour in the Processing
department.
• Normally direct labour is paid $9.60 per hour for a 32-hour week. Normal output is 24 units
per hour.
• Sometimes more experienced direct labour is available and is paid $10.50 per hour for a
30-hour week. Normal output is 30 units per hour.
• The company expects to make a gain on the cost of labour per unit by paying a higher rate to
more experienced employees.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
